title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions (true positives + false positives).

title: Effect of Increasing Threshold
text: Increasing the threshold generally means that fewer instances are classified as positive. This can affect precision, recall, and accuracy.

title: Precision and False Positives
text: If the threshold is increased, the number of false positives may decrease, potentially increasing precision.

title: Precision and True Positives
text: However, increasing the threshold might also decrease the number of true positives, which can decrease precision.

title: Precision Calculation
text: Consider the formula for precision: $$precision=true$$ positives/(true $$positives+false$$ positives). If true positives decrease more than false positives, what happens to precision?
